torch-native spinor or spinor-derived density branch states
QIT entropy/readouts derived from compressed field provenance

fixation_breakers: demote repeated Axis0/FEP/entropy/PEPS target to proxy unless all primary shell-field fields are preserved
if a worker suggests a scalar readout as the object, rerun with no_shell_orientation and scalar_entropy_only controls
each lateral lane must return to the shell field through preserved/lost/precondition/kill_control entries

lateral_mappings.kill_control: drop shell metadata and future_inward/past_outward orientation; any Axis0, gravity-model, or shell-field claim must fail or weaken
lateral_mappings.label: PEPS3D spinor carrier
loses: literal spherical shell meaning unless Sigma_r/event_x/r metadata remains attached
global possibility ontology unless Omega_r branches remain first-class
preconditions: shell_id and radius r are attached to carrier supports
adapter output cannot become the primary object
preserves: torch-native spinor or density branch states
lateral_mappings.target: finite PEPS3D/spinor carrier for shell branch states

lateral_mappings.kill_control: if entropy readout survives when Omega_r, shell orientation, and compression provenance are removed, it is only a scalar diagnostic
lateral_mappings.label: QIT entropy family
loses: future-continuation field if reported without Omega_r provenance
opening-vs-binding polarity if reduced to one scalar
preconditions: entropy is computed from rho_branch, rho_present, shell boundary state, path weights, or cut state with provenance
A0_raw remains vector-valued before any projection

lateral_mappings.kill_control: if FEP update exists without Omega_r future possibilities and compatibility compression, it cannot claim shell-field preservation
lateral_mappings.label: QIT-FEP/Holodeck local mirror
preconditions: must be derived after the shell-field object exists
must name prediction/projection, evidence/boundary, posterior/survivor, and a kill condition
preserves: projection then boundary-correction then survivor pattern
lateral_mappings.target: local mirror of the shell compression process

lateral_mappings.kill_control: if Axis0 scalar passes after shell direction is removed, it is not Axis0 alignment and cannot be promoted
lateral_mappings.label: Axis0/Phi0 candidate
preconditions: Xi_shell or Xi_hist bridge preserves shell metadata into rho_AB
Phi0 is treated as a candidate projection of A0_raw, not assumed

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first object-preservation failure before adding new layer, Axis0, flux, FEP, or physics work
loop_contract.stop_condition: all shell-field object errors pass and a continuation artifact names the next unrun variant, or a named primary object field is impossible/resource_blocked with receipt

primary_object_card.adapter_policy: PEPS3D, QIT entropy, FEP/Holodeck, Wolfram/ruliad, and Axis0 can be adapters/probes/analogies/proxies only if their preservation, loss, preconditions, and kill controls are explicit.
allowed_operations: construct Omega_r future/refinement branches on each shell
compress weighted branches inward into rho_present
derive QIT entropy/cut/path readouts from field provenance
run negative controls that remove shell direction, Omega_r, compatibility, PEPS3D anchor, or noncommuting order
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: system_v5/ops/formal_scouts/ results and continuation artifacts for v4.3 shell-field formal scouts
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: rho_present, outward_record, field readout vector including H_Omega/path entropy/QIT cuts/order gap/A0_raw candidates, plus controls and blocked consumers
primary_object_card.domain: finite PEPS3D shell stack K=(V,E,F,C), event_x, shell radii r, Omega_r branch sets, noncommuting path/Kraus/operator families, branch spinor-density states, compatibility witnesses

native_terms.i scalar: The shell radius/order parameter r, and only later a possible shell/cut functional G(rho_Br) that Axis0 must not forget.
native_terms.jk fuzz: The finite set Omega_r(x) of admissible future possibilities, refinements, histories, or continuations carried on shell Sigma_r(x).
native_terms.outward past record: The record trace/provenance/correlation residue emitted from the compressed survivor, moving outward from the present.
native_terms.present survivor: The present state produced by compatibility-weighting and compressing possible futures; it is not a single argmax branch.
native_terms.shell: Sigma_r(x), the finite spherical shell or shell-stratum at radius/order r around event or patch x.

primary_object_card.object_statement: A finite shell-indexed field of possible futures compresses inward through compatibility into a present survivor, while the past-facing outward record preserves what survived.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: A finite field of literal shell-indexed possible futures around event_x. Future continuations on Sigma_r compress inward through compatibility weights into a present survivor, while the past-facing outward_record preserves what survived. Entropy, Axis0, FEP, PEPS3D, Wolfram-style multiway language, and QIT cuts are readouts, carriers, analogies, or proxies derived from this object, not replacements for it.
required_invariants: survivor is derived from weighted futures
branch states rho_omega remain attached to Omega_r futures
readouts preserve provenance from Omega_r through compression

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Literal shells carry possible futures inward; past records move outward.
The sim order is future_continuation_field -> compatibility weights -> compression -> rho_present -> outward record -> derived readouts.

weirdness_signature: future possibilities are represented as first-class shell contents
future compression is inward while past record is outward
present survivor is derived from compatibility-weighted possible futures
entropy is a shell possibility/readout provenance pattern, not a lone scalar
